app.title: Names-On-Chain
app.subtitle: A Doichain name registration transaction generator
app.description: Register and trade Doichain names with PSBTs, without a private key in the browser

banner.after: : a PSBT you sign in your wallet spends real DOI. Check every output before you sign.

status.offlineHelp: Offline – please check your internet connection or reload the page.

name.label: Name to register
name.expired: It was registered before and expired at block {expiresAt}, so it can be registered again.

errors.space: A name must not contain spaces.
errors.tooLong: The name is {bytes} bytes long; Doichain allows at most {max} bytes.
errors.taken: The name "{name}" is already registered to the address {address}.
errors.takenUntil: The name "{name}" belongs to the address {address} until block {expiresAt}, {blocksLeft} blocks from now.
errors.pending: The name "{name}" is just being registered to the address {address}; the transaction is not in a block yet.

warnings.nonAscii: This name contains characters beyond ASCII. On chain it is stored as the bytes {hex}; names that look the same can consist of different bytes.
warnings.mixedScripts: This name mixes alphabets, for example Latin and Cyrillic letters that look alike. On chain it is stored as the bytes {hex}.

funds.insufficient: The funds on {address} are not enough for this Doichain name.
funds.insufficientForTransaction: The funds on {address} are not enough to build the transaction for this name.

address.label: Doichain registration address
address.scan: Scan the QR code of an address

features.title: Features:
features.static: Static web app, no server of its own
features.noKeys: No private key in the browser
features.serversSee: The ElectrumX servers see the addresses you enter
features.transfer: Scan the PSBT QR code or copy and paste the PSBT
features.marketplace: Create offers on the marketplace (coming soon)

fees.heading: Register a Doichain name for 36,000 blocks (about 250 days)

trade.seller: I own this name and want to make a sell offer.
trade.buyer: I don't own this name and want to make a buy offer.
trade.sellerHint: Creates part 1 of the PSBT to sell the name.
trade.buyerHint: Creates the PSBT part to buy the name (only if part 1 is known).
trade.sellerExplanation: If you own this name, you only need to enter the transfer price. The app adds an output with this price to the address that holds the name; you sign the name input in your wallet.
trade.fundingLabel: Doichain address with the funds to buy the name
trade.fundingScan: Scan the QR code of the funding address
trade.fundingTotal: Total UTXO value of the funding address: {amount}
trade.fundingInvalid: The funding address has no usable UTXOs.

scan.title: Scan a QR code
scan.tip: Hold a QR code in front of your camera.
